source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F (Annual Report 2025), Distribution of UBS Group AG shares
source.quote: Distribution of UBS Group AG shares As of 31 December 2025 Shareholders registered Shares registered ... Total shares registered 229,388 100.0 1,415,015,852 2 42.3

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM also holds UBS Group AG and subsidiary bonds in separate rows, not counted. NBIM's 2.9% matches the February 17, 2026 FMIA notification of a holding below 3%. CalPERS: the information table of its Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no UBS shares (searched by issuer name). Holders of record: registered shareholders in the UBS share register only (229,388 holding 1,415,015,852 shares, 42.3% of shares issued); 57.7% of shares issued were not registered, so the true number of holders is larger.
